sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kw motor.
The recorded demand forecast for part:350011 changed by +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
Your recorded on-time delivery rate is 90.4 % (sc:70510@2026Q3).
The referenced orders for part:350011 each record a price of EUR 348.32 per price unit (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20, po:4500014342-10, po:4500014238-20, po:4500014178-30, po:4500014178-20, po:4500014128-10).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
We commit to a binding volume of 6,110 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €368.68 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your commitment to a binding volume and the offer of faster payment terms, which allow us to adjust our pricing.
Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that it is our strict company policy not to disclose internal cost structures.
Based on the 14-day payment term and the increased volume, we can offer a revised price of EUR 368.68 per unit.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your revised offer and your continued commitment to the volume of 6,110 pieces.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our primary offer is a price of €372.23 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

We are pleased to select the 14-day payment option, which allows us to reduce our price to EUR 367.05 per unit. As an alternative, we offer a price of €367.05 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

This is a further step towards your target, and we look forward to concluding this agreement. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
